## Summary

- Add relative pipeline scheduling with months/days/hours/minutes, previous/next references, Russian relative labels, disabled inactive timing fields, and schedule border states.
- Replace pipeline-specific visualizer presets with saved visualizer presets, add album track file picking, and add a completion report for YouTube uploads sorted by publish date.
- Add per-stage and standalone YouTube playlist IDs, playlistItems insertion, combined OAuth scope handling, and preserved upload form options from PR #126.
- Add issue research notes under docs/case-studies/issue-131.

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#131

## Screenshot

![Pipeline scheduling](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-131-06cd8d2fd62d/docs/case-studies/issue-131/assets/pipeline-scheduling.png?raw=true)

## Tests

- npm run lint
- npm run typecheck
- npm test
- npm run build
- npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/youtube-upload-ui.cy.js
- npx cypress run (51 passing)
